## 6q22.33 Breast Cancer Susceptibility Locus
A genome-wide association study in the Ashkenazi Jewish genetic isolate identified a novel breast cancer susceptibility locus at 6q22.33 (rs2180341), confirmed in replication cohorts with a per-allele OR of 1.18 (95% CI 1.04–1.33, P = 0.0083) and strengthened in aggregate meta-analysis (OR 1.24, P = 3.85 × 10⁻⁷) [1].
